title: Experts disagree on src/authoring/lint/fields.ts
context:
Chief architect: The claims disagree on timing: narrow in this change, or wait until the fallback minor ends. Narrowing in this change is the only way the AC-C02 zero-blocking state stays protected against a new top-level key in a paqad skill. The narrowing covers the paqadRuntime allowance only, so users' skills still go through the parser fallback. Per EX-application-architect-3 it lands in a later commit than the move, after every paqad skill has moved. If the owner prefers EX-solution-architect-6, the allowance stays wide until the fallback is removed.

Target: src/authoring/lint/fields.ts
- skill-orchestrator: After the move, PAQAD_RUNTIME_SKILL_FIELDS narrows so a new top-level custom key in a paqad skill blocks under SK-006, while the parser fallback still reads old keys in users' own skills for one minor.
- solution-architect: Narrowing PAQAD_RUNTIME_SKILL_FIELDS waits until the fallback minor ends; narrowing it in this change makes skills from user projects that still use top-level keys fail lint while the parser still accepts them.
- application-architect: PAQAD_RUNTIME_SKILL_FIELDS is narrowed only after every skill has moved its keys under metadata; narrowing it in the same commit as the move would block the fallback window.
